title: Sonatine
identity: Forbidden Music Regained identifies Julius Hijman’s 1934 Sonatine for alto saxophone in E-flat and piano, with movements Allegretto, Andantino and Allegro con brio. The site provides archival background and a featured video, and says Hijman performed the sonatine in Paris in 1938. Its linked score is order-only; no notation was inspected.

evidence.claim: Identifies 1934 scoring, three movement names, published score and featured video.
Documents 1938 Paris performance and contemporary reception in critical reviews.

review_focus: The institutional work record confirms three contrasting movement tempo labels and historical performance context; inspect notation before describing its style or instrument-specific demands.
collection_flag: Historical published saxophone-and-piano sonatina with documented prewar performance; primary instrumentation metadata available.
gaps: Featured video title/performer and playback were not verified.
